1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “那红灵芝对身体好处。” Formula: Something + 对 + person/body + 有 + 好处 Correct: “那种红灵芝对身体有好处。” You need “有” before “好处.” “那种” is also more natural when referring to a type of mushroom.
